tagline: Building the energy-efficient digital infrastructure of the future
hero_kpi_rationale: Hashrate is the primary revenue driver in Bitcoin mining operations: the higher the computing power, the more actively the company participates in network validation and receives Bitcoin rewards. It is the fundamental KPI of the business model.

kpis.name: Computing Power (Hashrate)
kpis.explanation: Measures the computing power used to mine Bitcoin, in exahash per second (EH/s).
kpis.description: The company aims to continuously increase its hashrate through the expansion of its data centers in the United States.
kpis.signal: 45.6 EH/s on average as of end-September 2025, with a peak at 50 EH/s.

kpis.name: Bitcoin Held
kpis.explanation: Total number of bitcoins held by the company, including those in wallet and pledged as collateral.
kpis.description: The company holds a significant Bitcoin position, measured at fair value on the balance sheet.
kpis.signal: 10,428 BTC held + 2,583 BTC pledged = 13,011 BTC in total.

kpis.name: Contracted Power Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total electrical power under contract to power data centers.
kpis.description: Key energy infrastructure to support mining operations and future high-performance computing workloads (AI/HPC).
kpis.signal: 1,027 MW of contracted power capacity as of end-September 2025.

kpis.name: Miners in Service
kpis.explanation: Number of mining machines currently operational.
kpis.description: The company operates a large fleet of miners, with some units awaiting installation or repair.
kpis.signal: 241,934 miners in service out of a total of 336,544 held.

kpis.name: Average Energy Efficiency
kpis.explanation: Average energy consumption of miners in service, in watt per terahash.
kpis.description: Higher efficiency reduces operating costs and improves profitability.
kpis.signal: Average efficiency of 16.7 W/TH, a key indicator of competitiveness.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Modest headcount for a specialized digital infrastructure company.

kpis.name: AI and High-Performance Computing Development
kpis.explanation: Diversification strategy toward hosting AI and HPC workloads.
kpis.description: The company leverages its infrastructure expertise to develop dedicated capabilities for AI and HPC.
kpis.signal: Strategic diversification into AI and HPC announced in 2025, with land acquisition in Texas in October 2025 and 285 MW of power supply agreements.

kpis.name: Bitcoin Derivatives Usage
kpis.explanation: Use of derivatives to hedge Bitcoin price risk.
kpis.description: The company uses futures, options, and other instruments to manage Bitcoin volatility and monetize its holdings.
kpis.signal: Launch of institutional trading function in April 2025, use of Bitcoin-linked derivatives (futures, options, structured instruments).

risks.title: Bitcoin Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Bitcoin's value is subject to significant fluctuations, which can materially impact the company's financial results. Bitcoin prices ranged from $15,460 to $124,533 between October 2022 and September 2025.

risks.title: Energy Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on energy for its Bitcoin mining operations, which may be affected by energy price fluctuations.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a market with growing competition, which could affect its market share and revenues.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulations and laws that may change, potentially affecting its operations and financial results.

risks.title: Legal Disputes
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in legal disputes that could impact its financial results (see Note 19).

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on technology for its Bitcoin mining operations, which may be affected by technological advances and industry changes.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to credit risks if its customers or partners fail to meet their financial obligations.

ai_positioning.summary: CleanSpark is positioning its energy infrastructure capabilities to support AI and HPC workloads, although with no significant current revenue presence. The company is actively diversifying its portfolio toward AI/HPC hosting and acquired land in Texas in October 2025 with 285 MW of power supply agreements to develop a next-generation data center campus.
evidence: Infrastructure design to support Bitcoin mining and AI/HPC workloads
No AI/HPC revenue-generating equipment as of end-September 2025
